page.overview:
What is Far Downs?

The Far Downs were a small region of hills that lay beyond the western boundary of the Shire until its expansion in FO 31, becoming part of the Westmarch.

The Far Downs were forty leagues from the Brandywine Bridge and over forty miles from the Tower Hills. The town of Greenholm was built among them, and the Great East Road leading to the Tower Hills ran through. Fastred, the first Warden of Westmarch, was born on these hills in Greenholm.
